title: Big cats, unexplained lights and a floodlit eclipse — 7 skywatching 'horror stories' to keep you entertained this Halloween
caption:
Stargazing isn't always peaceful. From aggressive wildlife to freak weather, here are some of the most unfortunate mishaps astronomers have faced while out in the field.
